LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_Kingdom_Summary: K1–K5 cover Suiyin's background and your first collaboration. Later chapters are unfinished. The kingdom arc starts only when you open it here; select Suiyin as storyteller before starting.
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_Kingdom_NoGame: Load a game to start the kingdom arc manually.
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_Kingdom_RequiresSuiyin: Select Suiyin as storyteller to start the kingdom arc or receive her new commissions.
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_Kingdom_Disabled: New Hunger and Havoc content is disabled. The kingdom arc is paused.
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_Kingdom_Unavailable: The kingdom arc cannot open right now. Check the game log.
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_BroadcastCooldown_Tooltip: Days to wait after one broadcast before another. 0 to 10 days, default 3.
LanguageData.RHAH_Menu_Narrative_NoGame: Narrative state needs a loaded game.
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_Broadcast_Tooltip: Colonists can broadcast from a comms console to call famine ratkin here. Normally one group responds; during famine years, broadcasts try to call more distinct groups, using the visitor multiplier rounded up. Incident settings, appearance limits and the cooldown below still apply. Disabling this option stops new broadcasts. Groups already traveling keep coming.
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_IdentityPartialTrust_Toolt: Minimum trust for Suiyin to describe palace life. The relic event must be complete. Range -100 to 100, default 50.
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_IdentityFullTrust_Tooltip: Minimum trust for Suiyin to reveal that she is a princess. At least the partial disclosure threshold and at most 100. Default 75.
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_NarrativeKinds_Tooltip: Suiyin sends this letter after you have experienced at least this many kinds of incidents. Range 1 to 14.
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_NarrativeTheft_Tooltip: A grain hole can appear after this many thefts at one colony. Range 1 to 14 thefts, default 2.
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_NarrativeSilver_Tooltip: Base amount of silver Suiyin sends with the record letter. If her trust in you is above 0, she adds more silver in proportion to her trust. Range 0 to 10000, default 300.
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_NarrativeBonus_Tooltip: At trust 100, Suiyin adds this percentage of the base silver amount. Between trust 0 and 100, the bonus is reduced proportionally. Range 0 to 100%, default 25%.
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_NarrativeRescue_Tooltip: Silver paid to keep the banished mother or child. 0 to 10000, default 250.
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_NarrativeRescueReward_Tool: Silver dropped later after the ransom is paid. 0 to 20000, default 2500.
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_NarrativeTake_Tooltip: Silver gained by taking the migration record. 0 to 10000, default 200.
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_NarrativeHand_Tooltip: Silver gained by handing the migration record over. 0 to 10000, default 100.
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_NarrativeMissing_Tooltip: Suiyin considers a visitor missing after this many days without knowing their whereabouts. Range 0 to 60 days, default 1 day.
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_NarrativeObserve_Tooltip: The deadline for clarifying ordinary relief visitors' whereabouts, and the observation window for entrusted children to reach the child stage. Relief visitors who are still present can continue accumulating time alive. Range 0 to 120 days, default 30 days.
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_NarrativeHole_Tooltip: If you leave a grain hole alone, it disappears after this many days and the trail is lost. Range 0 to 30 days, default 3 days.
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_NarrativeEnvoyWait_Tooltip: The envoy waits up to this many days. If you leave the request unanswered, he leaves. Range 0 to 30 days, default 3 days.
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_NarrativeEnvoyCheck_Toolti: After you agree to check the envoy's account, he waits this many more days. Range 0 to 30 days, default 1 day.
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_NarrativeRelicDays_Tooltip: The migration record site remains available for this many days, then disappears from the world map. Range 0 to 120 days, default 15 days.
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_NarrativeYears_Tooltip: After a mother or child is banished, a caravan may encounter them again within this many years. Range 0 to 20 years, default 4. A year is 60 days.
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_NarrativeAside_Tooltip: Minimum interval between Suiyin's short notes. Range 0 to 30 days, default 3 days.
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_NarrativeCutoff_Tooltip: When Suiyin's trust falls to this value or lower, she stops sending short notes but still sends incident outcomes. Range -100 to 0, default -75.
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_NarrativeAdult_Tooltip: Age of the envoy Suiyin sends. Range 1 to 80 years, default 18.
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_TrustRange_Tooltip: Amount added to or subtracted from Suiyin's trust in you when this happens. Range -100 to 100; at 0, trust stays unchanged.
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_EnvoyMeals_Tooltip: Simple meals required to trade with the envoy. 0 to 100, default 6.
